result.brief: 提出统一离散扩散大模型 NLD-Uni，用跨范式在线策略蒸馏把自回归 VLM 的理解能力与连续流模型的生成能力迁移到同一 DLLM，并以渐进自精炼扩散替代掩码扩散，实现理解与生成的统一。
result.reason: Unified discrete diffusion LLM sharing one model for visual understanding and generation, with cross-paradigm distillation and progressive self-refining diffusion; matches unified understanding/generation.
